preregistration.primary_strategy: Phase 2I threshold pool, tau = 0.99, on base-label targets (sad, happy, energetic, calm) only; selection, shares and interleaving unchanged; angry/stressed keep production logic; calm candidates exclude speechiness > 0.66 (never relaxed); the existing never-shrink fallback (production pool if fewer than 20 x share pass tau) and any shortfall are counted.
preregistration.sensitivity_strategy: Same with tau = 0.95; reported against the same criteria; cannot replace the primary.
preregistration.confidence_matched_baseline: Per request, the recommender's target shares filled uniformly at random (src.music_evaluation.random_eligible_list, RandomState(21000), same draw order as earlier phases, 50 lists) from each target's population: for base-label targets, exactly the strategy's candidate pool (guarded eligibility, signal >= tau, with the same never-shrink fallback); for angry/stressed, their full current eligibility (no probability floor is invented). It measures the diversity attainable among candidates meeting the same confidence requirement, not the maximum diversity of all eligible tracks. Unrestricted random-eligible (production and guarded eligibility) and production results are secondary references.
preregistration.calm_scoring: Calm-only configuration counted once (chill/match = stressed/uplift); both aliases reported; calm compared with unguarded production on identical seeds; speech-like spread is never counted as an improvement.
preregistration.paired_gate: Lower 95% bootstrap bound > 0 versus production for happy/sad/energetic/stressed match. A component is NOT ESTABLISHED when the strategy leaves that target's selection identical to production (stressed: derived logic unchanged by pre-registration), since the comparison is then between identical algorithms. Gate = FAIL if any component fails, else NOT ESTABLISHED if any is, else PASS.
preregistration.signal_gate: Mean served classifier probability over every base-label-target slot in all 12 requests >= 0.99. The earlier all-target ranking-signal mean (which mixes in derived scores) is also reported, with mean, 5th percentile and minimum per base-label target. A mean pass is not a per-track floor.
preregistration.old_results: Phase 2H.9 and 2I results and gate statuses stand as recorded; the baseline definition here is new and is not applied to them.

stressed / match.why: selection for this derived target is identical to production by pre-registration

notes: Diversity is feature-space diversity (mean pairwise distance in the 9 z-scored audio features), not listener-perceived variety.
Bootstrap intervals resample one request's 50 runs on one catalog: sampling variability only, no listener-level or cross-user significance.
The confidence-matched baseline is new in this phase; Phase 2H.9 and 2I gate statuses are unchanged.
Precision/NDCG are omitted: relevance is the eligibility definition.
Latency is machine-dependent; cold start uses fresh interpreters on sad/match.
